about: Real testnet transactions and read-only views, one per thing Pot claims to do. scripts/verify-proofs.mjs checks every entry (read-only, no keys, no install) and docs/judging-guide.md J-10 lists them. Every tx except the simulated cross-chain delivery (sent directly by treasury.potprev.testnet, the testnet stand-in for 1Click) is a NEP-366 delegate: the person signed it with 0 NEAR, and the relayer users.potprev.testnet sent it and paid the gas.

txs.action: Start a Pot under the current rules (policy v3)
txs.shows: The hub creates test-gktq.pots.potprev.testnet as a Sputnik DAO from the global code and stores its rules and its first invite, in one signed call.
The hub checks the invite's ed25519 signature, files AddMemberToRole in the DAO and approves it with its 1-of-1 rulebot seat.
An ft_transfer_call to the hub moves test dollars into the Pot's DAO and records the contribution (the relayer pays the 1 yoctoNEAR deposit).

txs.action: A small spend approved by the rules alone
txs.shows: The hub checks the Pot's rules, files a Transfer proposal and approves it with its rulebot seat; the DAO pays out in the same call chain. Nobody voted.

txs.action: A bigger spend paid after one other member's OK
txs.shows: Another member's OK goes to the hub, which checks it is allowed (not the payee, joined earlier, within the one-OK limit) and approves the DAO transfer: $180 is paid.

txs.action: A spend decided by a group vote
txs.shows: Leo's VoteApprove goes straight to the Pot's DAO; it is the deciding vote (2 of 3), so the DAO pays the $300 in the same transaction.

txs.action: Ask the group to close the Pot
txs.shows: The hub files one FunctionCall proposal holding every member's pro-rata refund; members then approve it.

txs.action: Close: everyone gets their share back
txs.shows: The deciding approval of the close runs every refund in one receipt (two ft_transfers here, one per member).

txs.action: Someone outside the group chips in
txs.shows: A non-member pays into a Pot through its public page; the hub records it as a gift, not a member's contribution.

txs.action: Get paid by a pay link
txs.shows: A payee outside the Pot claims an approved spend through its link; the hub checks the link's signature and the DAO pays.

txs.action: A spend with a scanned receipt's fingerprint
txs.shows: The spend's request_ref is its 16-character operation key followed by 592a265a80b96f78, the first 64 bits of the saved receipt's SHA-256.

txs.action: Money from another chain arrives (simulated on testnet)
txs.shows: There is no NEAR Intents testnet, so after a real 1Click quote the simulator (treasury.potprev.testnet) delivers the quoted dollars to the member; the next row is the member putting them in.
The delivered dollars go into the Pot in the same minute, recorded as a contribution.

views.what: The hub's version and its only relayer
A current Pot: members can only vote; only the hub files proposals
Earned trust: after settled spends, ben's instant limit doubled
The public record: every spend with its tier and who approved it
